rules: 999px pill radii are semantic pill/circle geometry, not sequential Size Tree nodes.
Negative arrow/drop-indicator offsets are structural geometry and require paired consumer migration.
3px/5px/7px values require visual consumer review before normalization; no value-only replacement.
Responsive .9px max boundaries preserve current breakpoint behavior until the responsive contract is migrated explicitly.
1.5px checkbox glyph strokes are visual stroke geometry, not spacing tokens.
-0.5px Tree line transforms center a 1px hairline and must remain paired with the 1px line unless redesigned.

viewportUnits.rule: Replace per containing-block/overlay geometry. Fixed full-screen owners should prefer inset/percentage geometry; popup/preview consumers require parent-size verification before removing viewport units.

cssGridAndFr.rule: Convert internal CSS Grid layouts to Flex per consumer while preserving the framework 24-column Grid component's existing Flex math.

jsGeometry.rule: Separate legitimate measurement infrastructure (positioning/scroll/virtualization/observers/motion) from hard-coded CSS-size coupling. Do not remove runtime measurement solely because it reads geometry.

nextPhaseRule: Phase C/D may map tokens only after consumer decisions preserve interaction, breakpoints, overlay geometry and motion contracts.
